text: Write a long, slow paragraph about the sea. Use many short sentences.

response: The sea is vast and mysterious. It covers most of our planet's surface. The ocean's depths are largely unexplored. There are still many species of fish we've never seen. Coral reefs are home to an incredible array of life. Sea turtles migrate thousands of miles each year. They can live up to 80 years. The sea is also where many of our planet's nutrients come from. Phytoplankton photosynthesize and release oxygen. This oxygen supports all life on Earth. The sea plays a crucial role in regulating the Earth's climate.
